name: live_npc_targets_players
description: Two geckos fight the party in Doc Mitchell's house, and each machine's threat director (CombatBridge::retarget, coop-core ThreatDirector) decides whom each attends to. The host stands at (2289, 1700) and the guest far off at (2289, 3700). Gecko 1 waits at Doc Mitchell, gecko 2 at the host, and both start combat on the host's player. Distance: at 6 s the guest walks up to gecko 1 (44 units, the host 544), so gecko 1 moves to the guest's machine (the nearest player owns it) and attends to the guest. Threat: gecko 2 stays next to the host, but at 9 s the guest hits it hard from 500 units away, so it attends to the guest. combat.targets (enemy to player, from each machine's combat state; the owner sends its own player as its puppet form) must name the guest for both geckos on both peers.
